raw_text: China's coast guard fired water cannons at Philippine boats carrying supplies to a military outpost in the South China Sea, Manila said, the latest in a series of confrontations in the disputed waterway. The incident occurred near Second Thomas Shoal, where the Philippines deliberately grounded a World War II-era ship in 1999 to stake its territorial claim. Beijing claims nearly the entire South China Sea.
